notes: SR37 The Novogratz (www.shopthenovogratz.com, Wix Stores). Access: plain direct HTTP fetch (curl), robots.txt allows all, no proxy/Playwright needed. Investigation for Clearance: (1) enumerated all 24 URLs in store-categories-sitemap.xml - none named sale/clearance/outlet/final/last-chance/end-of-line/discontinued (categories present are Furniture, Lighting, Textiles/Rugs, Wallpaper, Fireplaces, Best Sellers, New Arrivals, Decor+Gifts, and furniture/lighting sub-leaves only); (2) checked the homepage's full main-nav/footer link set (fetched raw HTML) - identical category list, no Sale/Clearance/Outlet nav item and no 'clearance'/'outlet'/'sale'/'last chance'/'final sale'/'end of line'/'discontinued' text anywhere on the homepage; (3) checked pages-sitemap.xml (non-category static pages: about-us, contact-us, terms-of-service, accessibility-statement, privacy-policy, home) - no sale/clearance page; (4) probed 9 candidate slugs directly (/category/sale, /category/clearance, /category/outlet, /category/clearance-sale, /category/final-sale, /category/last-chance, /category/end-of-line, /category/discontinued, /category/deals) - all returned 404; (5) tried the site's own search at /search?q=clearance - the SSR HTML only echoes the query string in requestUrl metadata, no server-rendered result count or product listing is present (Wix site search is client-side rendered so this does not itself prove absence, per the zero-result-search caveat), but combined with the exhaustive sitemap/nav/candidate-URL check above there is no genuine Clearance, Outlet, Final Sale, Last Chance, or End-of-Line merchandising PLP anywhere on this small direct-sell catalogue. This is a small designer-brand site (~30 category leaves total) with a fully enumerable nav/sitemap, so the absence is well-supported. No Sale-vs-Clearance ambiguity arose because no sale-type page of any kind (temporary or permanent) was found at all.
